name: Easy Cheesy Chicken Enchilada Casserole with Bell Pepper, Onion & Cilantro-Lime Crema

instructions.primary_message: Cut tortillas in half, then cut crosswise into 1/2-inch strips. Place in a large bowl along with chicken, veggies, enchilada sauce, half of the cheese, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine, transfer to a large baking dish, and spread out in an even layer. Sprinkle with remaining cheese.
instructions.secondary_message:
907 g cooked chicken (shredded)
2 (396 g) bag frozen pepper strips
1 (794 g) can red enchilada sauce
3 cups shredded cheese, Mexican blend
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place baking dish in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake until the cheese is golden and casserole is warmed through, about 1 hour. Remove from oven.

Meanwhile, wash and dry cilantro and lime. Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Place in a small bowl. Zest and juice lime into the bowl, then add sour cream and spices. Stir to combine the crema and refrigerate until ready to serve.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ small bunch cilantro
1 lime
1 cup sour cream
½ tsp garlic powder
¼ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide casserole between plates or bowls. Drizzle with cilantro-lime crema and enjoy!
